title: Japanese hitodama soul orbs

tellings.quote: Japanese concept of the hitoama but it's these uh plasma orbs

plain: In Japan there is an old idea of the hitodama, glowing balls of light that Michels describes as a kind of plasma orb, often taken to be souls. Michels raises it himself, linking it to the film The Boy and the Heron by the Japanese animator Hayao Miyazaki, in a talk about UFOs, psychics and the afterlife. He brings it up because such orbs echo lights reported in UFO accounts.
